source: 100STYLE by Ian Mason, Sebastian Starke and Taku Komura, CC BY 4.0; retargeted and cut as HumanMotionCraft Crouch walk 7, then adapted to this character.
notes: Idle is constructed from mirrored directions of captured frame 48, not a recorded idle. Walking pelvis, thighs and shins begin from an adapted 100STYLE cycle; arms use the earlier trial. In-place, yaw removed, cycle crossfaded, floor adjusted and slowed from 1.2 to 1.6 seconds. Feet are raised during swing and the legs receive a baked support-point IK fit at 0.38 m/s; this is not dynamic contact locking.
